about_the_game:
After a night of a sugar-fueled tv marathon, a group of friends fall into a deep slumber and find themselves in a strange dream world. Jump, climb, and explore as you work with your friends (or against them) to complete puzzles and reach the end. Help the Familiars along the way, collect, trading cards, and zipline through multiple levels in order to hit the alarm clock and make it to the bus on time!

- Embark on a journey with up to three of your friends as you (sugar) rush your way though an exciting 3D Platform puzzle game. Press buttons, gather tasty snacks, unlock the adorable familiars, and zipline through an exciting adventure!

CO-OP fun! - Invite up to 3 of your friends to help (or hinder) your progress! (While we don't endorse pushing your friends off a cliff, we cannot deny it's very funny)

Friend or Foe? - Battle it out in our competitive modes in a race to the finish!

Wake up on time! - Run through the levels and slam the alarm clock buzzer to wake yourself up in time for the bus!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/8.1/10 x86 and x64
  • Processor: Intel Core2 Duo E6750 (2 * 2660) or equivalent | AMD Athlon 64 X2 Dual Core 6000+ (2 * 3000) or equivlent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce FT 740 (2048 MB) or equivalent | Radeon HD 5770 (1024 MB)
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Ready, Set, Slumberparty! Play as one of the many pajama-clad characters as they try to wake up on time for school!
